Commentary.Commentary: So, that will be it from this game! India march on to the semifinal of the ICC U-19 World Cup. On 29th January, 2020, the 2nd Quarter-Final will take place between the West Indies U19s and New Zealand U19s. Do join us for that game at 1000 Local (0800 GMT). Till then, cheers and take care!

Indian skipper, Priyam Garg, admits they wanted to field first as well. Tells their openers started off well but they lost their way in the middle and lost wickets hence they failed to get to 260. Tells they knew they had a very good score as they felt they had the bowling attack to defend 180-190 but was happy that the lower middle order could take him to 230. Tells that team spirit and team combination does not come in a month or two. Tells they have been playing and preparing for the past 18 months. On how pleased he is to be in the semi final, Garg says that all the games for them are the same as they play with the same intensity as every team that comes wants to win the cup.

Australian skipper, Mackenzie Harvey, says that it is not an easy loss to take. Adds they gave it their all and credits India for the game they had. Tells they hardly did anything wrong with the ball. Says he does not regret bowling first. Adds the Indian tailenders scoring 80 runs off the last 10 overs hurt them. Tells the wicket was not easy to bat on but was good enough to chase 230. Credits Fanning for keeping them in the chase. Admits that the changing room atmosphere was not great at 17/4. Knew they had batters to come who could have changed things. Admits that things could have been different had they got a good start.

For his superb exhibition of fast bowling and demolishing figures of 8-0-24-4, Kartik Tyagi has been named the Man of the Match. Tyagi says that the ball was swinging well and he is happy to perform well for the team especially after not being at his best in the last two games. Tells he bowled too many wides in the previous games, so here he was just trying to maintain his lines and lengths. On the semi finals, Kartik says no one knows what will happen in the future so he is just hoping to perform well in the coming games.

Earlier in the day, the Australians bowled really well to restrict India to a score of 233. Australia did well to take 3 wickets soon in the innings. Yashasvi Jaiswal played a very good innings at the top scoring 62 runs but he did not get any support until the pair of Bishnoi and Atharva Ankolekar did really well to add valuable runs down the order. The wickets were spread across the Australian bowling attack but the pick of them was Matthew Willans who used the pitch very well and suffocated the Indian batters at the start bowling consistently at the start. Stay tuned for the presentation which is coming right up!

Coming to the bowling of the Indians, Kartik Tyagi was the superstar as he dismantled the Aussie top order with his 4-fer. The other bowlers also kept things tight. Akash Singh took the all-important wicket of Sam Fanning and wrapped up the tail as well while Ravi Bishnoi dismissed concussion substitute Liam Scott. All in all, it was a very professional and thorough bowling performance from the Indians.

It was a dream start for the Indians as Australia shot on their own foot. On the first ball, Jake Fraser-McGurk departed for a diamond duck as he was run out. Two more wickets fell in the same over as Harvey and Hearne both departed off Tyagi's bowling. Tyagi also sent Oliver Davies packing and Australia found themselves at 17/4. After that came the resistance, as opener Sam Fanning and Patrick Rowe combined to form a 51-run stand. Just when it looked the Aussies would get a move on, Tyagi struck again to send Patrick Rowe back. He was a thorn for the Australians and ripped through their batting line-up. Liam Scott then combined with Fanning for a 81-run stand. It looked like this would be a match-winning stand for the Aussies but Ravi Bishnoi dismissed Scott and that broke the Australian resistance as they folded from 149/5 to 159 all out. The Australians were feeling pretty hard done by from some of the decisions made by the umpires but they could not do anything about it.

What a performance from India! Usually it is with the bat but this time, the defending champions have completely dominated with the ball and convincingly defeated Australia to progress to the semifinals of the ICC U-19 World Cup!!!

OUT! Bowled! Aakash Singh has wrapped up the innings! Superb performance from the defending champions, especially with the ball. Full and straight on middle and off. You miss, I hit stuff from Aakash. Willans looks to drive but misses and the ball goes onto hit the middle and off pole. INDIA WIN BY 74 RUNS!
Good length ball on off, Willans defends it off his back foot.
Length ball on off, Sangha strokes it to point.
Full and straight on middle, Willians manages to get bat on ball.
Yorker on middle, Sangha manages to squeeze it to third man for a single.
Another very full ball outside off, Sangha looks to get bat on ball but misses.
Wild swing but nothing. Full outside off, Willans swings his bat at it but misses.
Fuller on off, Willans pushes it through covers for a run.
Length ball just outside off, Willans looks to put bat on ball but he misses.
Kartik Tyagi comes on to bowl now and he will surely be eyeing his 5-fer. Can he wrap up the Australian innings?
Full on the pads, Willians flicks it towards fine leg for a single. End of a game changing over from Akash Singh. He has caught the game by the scruff of its neck and killed it.
Matthew Willans is the last man in.

OUT! TIMBER! India have got three wickets in three balls and are now just one wicket away from victory. Good length ball just around off, it angles into Murphy who looks to guide it down to third man. Australia's promising run chase after a torrid start has been slammed down the ground in this over by Akash Singh.
Todd Murphy is the new man in.

OUT! Run Out! Excellent work from Dhruv Jurel. Good length delivery on middle, Sangha looks to defend but does so off the inner half of his bat. The ball goes behind and Sully calls for a quick run. Dhruv Jurel charges to the ball and removes his glove on his way. He scores a direct hit with an underarm throw. The umpire goes upstairs and replay finds Sully short of his crease. The end looks near for Australia.
Direct hit and Sully looks to be in trouble. The umpire has gone upstairs but by the looks of it, Conor Sully looks to be short of his crease.
Tanveer Sangha is the new man in.

OUT! Caught! Is this the end of the Australian fight? Their warrior and fighter of this innings, Sam Fanning is out of here. The short ball does the trick for Akash Singh. Not the best of balls but he is not complaining. It is a short ball down the leg side. Fanning looks to pull but ends up gloving it behind to Dhruv Jurel who takes a simple catch. A very good innings of 75 from Fanning comes to an end. He is disappointed as he knows the responsibility of taking his side home was on his shoulder.
Full and on middle, played towards the man at mid on.
Back of a length ball on off, played towards the man at point.
Shorter on off, CS defends it to see off the over. Garg and Bishnoi won't complain about it.
FOUR! Poor ball and Sully gets the boundary that will release a hint of pressure from his side and himself. On the pads, Connor tickles it fine to the fence.
Flatter on off, Fanning defends it with soft hands towards cover and gets a single.
Straighter one outside off, Fanning leaves it alone.
On the pads, Sully flicks it towards square leg and gets off the mark. More importantly gives Fanning the strike.
Connor Sully is the new man in. Can he be the saviour for Australia yet again, playing a quickfire knock?

OUT! Caught! Big wicket for India as Liam Scott, who had just started to get his groove departs. Quicker one from Bishnoi. It is short and just outside off. Liam looks to play the cut but the ball is too close to do that. He still does and misses. There is a sound as the ball goes past the bat. Jurel takes a sharp catch and puts in an appeal. The umpire raises his finger but Liam is not happy. Unsure whether he is disappointed with the decision or his shot selection. Anyway, he will have to walk back. Brilliant start to Powerplay 3 for India. Disastrous one for the Aussies.
Powerplay 3 is underway! A maximum of 5 fielders are now allowed outside the circle until the end of the innings.
Full around off, Liam strokes it towards sweeper cover for a single. 85 needed off the last 10 overs.
Full on off, Scott squeezes it to mid on.

SIX! Don't even bother looking, that was six the moment he hit that ball. Good length delivery on off, Scott hangs on his back foot and smokes it two rows behind the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Liam now joining the party.
Come around the wicket and bangs it in short. Scott ducks under it.
Length ball on middle, it comes in with the angle. Fanning turns it with the angle towards fine leg for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Fanning looks to help it down towards backward point but misses. Ohhs and ahhs from the Indian players.
Akash Singh is back on. Can he provide the breakthrough that the Indians dearly need? Skipper Garg trying everything in his arsenal now!
Dot to end the over. On the stumps, Scott blocks it. 93 needed in 66 now.
Flighted outside off, Fanning paddles it to the leg side for a single.

Appeal for caught behind but the umpire is unmoved. Googly outside off, Fanning looks to defend but gets beaten. There is a huge and hopeful appeal from the keeper and the bowler but the umpire is not bothered.
Floated on off, Scott rotates the strike as he hits it wide of cover.
Flighted on off, Scott pushes it to mid off.
Tossed up on middle, Scott comes down and hits it back to the bowler.
Ravi Bishnoi is back on.

SIX! This is what Australia needed and Fanning has spoilt Veer's over. Tossed up on middle, Fanning comes down the track and plays the inside out shot over extra cover for a biggie. A very difficult shot to play but he has made it look easy.
Short around off, Fanning punches it back towards the bowler.
Tossed up on off, Liam milks it past mid off towards long off for a run.
Flatter and wide outside off, Scott reaches that but cannot time it well. Only hits it towards mid off. Another dot here.
Flighted on middle, Liam paddles it fine down the leg side for a couple.
Shorter ball on middle and off, Scott punches it back to the bowler.

Another ball wide outside off, Fanning cuts it over point but this time the fielder in the deep has been moved a bit squarer. He manages to dive and save runs for his side. 7 off the over. 104 needed in 78 now.

FOUR! Good shot from Fanning! Length ball outside off, Fanning loves the width as he is a very good player of the cut shot and he cuts it hard through point for a boundary. Dominic Cork on air feels Fanning reminds him of Sir Andrew Strauss.
This is a superb over so far from Tyagi. Another dot ball. Just 1 off his first 4 balls. This one is a back of a length delivery around the body, Fanning hops and blocks it.
Length delivery around off, Fanning pushes it to point.
Yorker, Fanning manages to dig it out.
Good length delivery around off, Scott runs it down to third man for a single.
Flighted outside off, Scott goes for the big sweep but does not time it well. It goes wide of deep mid-wicket so just a single.
Smart bowling from Veer! He sees Sam getting ready for a big slog sweep so he bowls it quicker and fuller on middle. Fanning adjusts and flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Short outside off, Fanning punches it wide of deep cover and gets another couple.
This time manages to punch it away from the fielder for a single.
Shorter on off, Scott punches it to the off side.

Had Jurel collected that cleanly, Scott might have been in trouble. Flighted off spinner outside off, Scott looks to drive but misses. He drags his foot out but then comes back in. Jurel fails to collect the ball and hence does not dislodge the bails.
Veer is back.
Good length ball around off, defended towards the off side.
Another back of a length ball on middle, played towards the point fielder.
Back of a length delivery, on the body of Fanning, he stands tall and defends it onto the pitch.
Full ball outside off, played towards sweeper cover for a single. The 50-RUN STAND COMES UP AS WELL. Some fight being shown here.

Aggression from Tyagi! Full ball on middle and off, played back towards Tyagi, he collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but instead hits Scott. There was no need for a throw there and this is unnecessary stuff.
Full ball on middle and off, defended towards the cover region.
Wide! Tyagi starts with a wide one outside off, Scott goes after it but misses.
Kartik Tyagi is back on. Can he provide the breakthrough and complete his 5-fer along with it?

SIX! Fanning finally cuts it loose and decides to tonk one over the mid-wicket fence. His second of the innings. Atharva tosses one up outside off, Fanning gets down on one knee and demolishes the sweep over mid-wicket fence for a biggie. 11 off the over. Australia need 116 from 96 balls.
On middle, Scott strokes it through mid on for a run.
Quicker one on off, Scott looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

FOUR! Welcome back boundary for Australia and they needed this very badly. On the pads, Scott flicks it through mid-wicket. The fielder gives it a chase and almost pulls it back before the ropes but fails. Australia need much more of these.
Tossed up on off, LS pushes it to mid off.
Shorter on off, Scott cuts it but straight to backward point.
Fuller on off, SF pushes it to cover. Another quiet over from India just a couple of the over.
Extra bounce on this one. It is pitched outside off and the ball shoots up off the surface. Fanning looks to play it on the off side but does so off the upper half of his bat.
Back of a length on the body, Fanning hops and taps it onto the ground.
On a length around middle and leg, Scott turns it to the leg side for a single.
Swing and a miss. Length ball outside off, it comes in with the angle. Fanning has a slash at it but cannot connect with anything but thin air.
Good length ball on middle, Fanning tucks it to the on side for a single.

DRINKS!!! India are well and truly in command here. Australia need 131 from 108 and have 5 wickets in hand. The run rate is inching towards 7.5 but they have Fanning who is well set out there. He though needs someone to partner him. India have done well so far with the ball and will look to get rid of Fanning and put the game to bed.
Quicker delivery again, played towards mid on for nothing.
Quicker delivery on middle and leg, pushed towards mid on.
Floated delivery on off, defended towards the off side.

Fifty for Fanning! He is keeping the fight alive for the Aussies. He has kept on losing partners at the other end but he has stuck and fought it out in the middle. He knows the job is not done here and he needs to keep on going if his side is to win this game. Very full outside off, Fanning strokes it towards point and gets a single to get to his milestone. Time now for Fanning to accelerate but he will also need someone to support him.
Just over! Floated delivery on middle and leg, Scott just about manages to chip it over Ankolekar's head and the batters take one.
Quicker delivery on the boots, pushed down to mid on.

Direct hit and it would have been danger for Sam. Fuller on off, Liam defends it towards cover and calls for a quick single. The fielder gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
On the stumps, defended by Liam defends it.
Length ball around off, LS plays it to point.
Very good ball. Good length delivery outside off, Scott looks to defend but misses.
Full around off, Scott blocks it.

Good length ball around off, Fanning taps it towards point for a single. A bit of an argy bargy. While taking the single, Fanning brushes the bowler's arm. Akash is very angry and shows his anger, complaining to his captain as well. Now, Fanning apologizes. You don't want to make a fast bowler angry, do you? That also brings up the 100 for Australia. Australia need another 134 from 119 balls now.
Akash Singh is into the attack. 4-0-16-0, his figures so far.
Fanning goes onto the back foot and punches this one through the cover region for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Quicker delivery this time pushed towards mid off.
Ankolekar floats it up around off, Scott pushes it back towards the bowler.
Shorter on off, Scott blocks it.
Flighted on off, Scott defends it.
Pitched on middle and off, watchfully defends.
Floated delivery on middle and off, Fanning prods forward and defends.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated delivery outside off, Fanning decides to leave this one.
FOUR! Good execution by Fanning! Floated ball on middle and leg, Fanning goes down on one knee and paddles this one fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Tossed up delivery on middle and off, pushed down to long on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short on off, Liam punches it towards cover for a run.
Tossed up on off, Liam plays it back to the bowler.
Floated on off, Scott taps it back to the bowler.
Short outside off, Liam punches it to point for one.
Shorter on middle, Scott punches it to long on for a single.
Flatter delivery on middle, Fanning defends it from within the crease.
Tossed up delivery on the off pole line, it turns away. Fanning looks to defend but the ball goes off the outer half of the bat towards point.
Scott pushes this one down to long off for one.
Floated delivery on middle and off, Scott prods forward and defends.
Similar delivery, Scott again looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Floated delivery on the off pole line, turning in, Scott looks to defend but the ball goes off the inside edge and thuds into the pads.
On off, Scott pushes it towards cover and keeps the strike. He also manages to take the Aussies score past the dreaded number.
Fuller on off, Liam blocks it off the front foot.
On the pads, Fanning glances it fine down the leg side for a single. The score now stands at the dreaded number for Australia, 87.
Back of a length on off, Fanning blocks it.

EDGED AND FOUR! Length delivery around off, shaping away from the southpaw. Fanning looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge which goes wide of the man at slip. Yashasvi at third man dives but cannot stop the ball.
Bouncer! Fanning sits under it.

Googly pitching on middle and leg. It is short in length. Scott goes on his back foot and looks to defend but misses. The ball hits him on the pads away from the leg pole. There is a hopeful appeal from the Indians but the umpire is not interested.
Floated on off, Scott pushes it to mid off.
Wrong 'un from Bishnoi. It is on middle and off, Scott manages to get his bat down and pushes it towards mid on.
Tossed up on off, Scott blocks it.
Flatter outside off, Fanning dabs it towards point for a run.
On the pads, Scott glances it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Ravi Bishnoi is back on. 4-0-10-0, his figures so far. Can he weave his web and strangle the Australian batters?
FOUR! A much-needed boundary from Fanning. A real shot of intent from the southpaw. Good length ball outside off, Sam slashes it over point and gets a boundary. 154 needed in 156 now.
On a length on middle, Liam tucks it to the leg side and gets a single. The asking rate goes over 6.0 now.
Good length ball on the stumps, Scott blocks it.
Length delivery around the pads, Fanning tucks it towards mid-wicket and looks for two but he will have to be happy with a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full outside off, Fanning pushes it towards point.
Sushant Mishra is into the attack. 4-0-16-0, his numbers so far.
Full outside off, Liam leaves it alone.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Liam looks to play but then keeps his bat down and sways away from it.
Full on off, Scott pushes it to cover.
Fuller on middle, Scott pushes it to mid on.
On the pads, Scott looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.

Brilliant from Bishnoi once again. Jeez this young man is a live wire on the field. Full outside off, Fanning taps it to the right of point. It looks like it will be a boundary but Bishnoi dives and saves the ball inside the circle. He cannot hold onto it but saves 3 runs for his side. Just a single.
Quicker delivery on the off pole line, Scott pushes it towards the man at mid off.
Loopy delivery on middle and off, slog swept towards mid-wicket for one.
Darted outside off now, played towards point.
Loopy on middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.
Tossed up delivery wide outside off, Fanning pushes it towards the man at cover.
Floated on off, defended back towards the bowler by Fanning.

FOUR! A super effort in the field from Bishnoi but he cannot save the boundary. A fuller ball around off, Liam gets on his front foot and drives it through covers. Bishnoi gives it a chase. He pulls it back just before the ropes and it's a touch-and-go thing. The batters take two runs. The on-field umpire wants to go upstairs to have a look and after a few replays, the third umpire indicates to the on-field umpire that it is a boundary. The first concussion based substitute in Under-19 World Cup is off the mark.
Good length ball outside off, Scott leaves it alone.
Full on the stumps, Liam pushes it towards mid on.

Nasty delivery to face first up and Scott is lucky to survive that. Pacy ball which is full around the pads. Liam looks to flick but misses and the ball hits him on the pads. There is a huge, confident appeal from the Indians but the umpire is unmoved. Looked to be going down the leg pole.
Liam Scott is the new man in. He is playing as a concussion substitute for Corey Kelly. Can he play a match-winning innings and save the Aussies?

OUT! Caught! Priyam Garg's decision to give the ball to his strike bowler has done the trick. Tyagi strikes in his comeback over and what a game he is having. He is just in his fourth over and he has his 4th wicket. A wicket which every fast bowler cherishes. It is on the channel of uncertainty around off. It moves away just a bit off the deck. Rowe looks to defend but the away movement sees it kiss the outside edge of Patrick's bat and go straight into the gloves of Jurel. The budding stand is broken and Australia's hopes take a major hit.
Length delivery outside off, Rowe leaves it alone.
India's strike bowler is back on. Kartik Tyagi is back into the attack. 3-0-8-3, his numbers so far.
Just a single off the over. Australia need 166 in 180 balls now. Flighted on off, SF gets on his front foot and taps it onto the ground.
Short again on off, Fanning looks to defend but does so off the inner half of the bat and onto his pads.
Shorter on off, Sam punches it to cover.
Tossed up on off, Fanning lunges forward and defends it.
Flighted on off, Sam defends it with a straight bat.
Tossed up on off, Rowe milks it to long off and eases to the other end.

50-run stand up between the pair of Fanning and Rowe. They came in at a difficult time and have managed to steady the ship. Their job is not done yet and they will need to carry on their rescue work. They have played with confidence so far and need to continue that. Floated on the pads, Patrick flicks it towards backward square leg and keeps the strike.
Tossed up on off, Fanning milks it to long on and takes the partnership to 49.
Shorter on off, Fanning punches it to cover.
Floated around off, Rowe strokes it through cover and rotates the strike.
Flighted on middle and leg, Fanning comes down the track and whips it towards long on for a single.
Flatter on the pads, Rowe turns it behind square on the leg side and gets a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Ankolekar prods forward and defends.
Floated delivery on middle and off, Rowe pushes this one down the ground towards long on for a single.
On the pads of Rowe, he has flicked this one towards the leg side but no runs on offer.
Loopy delivery on middle and leg, defended.
Tossed up delivery on middle and off, driven towards mid off and the batters take one.
Floated delivery on off, pushed towards the off side.
Atharva Ankolekar is on now.
Floated on off, Patrick pushes it to mid off.

Oh! Floated outside off, Rowe looks to drive but misses as the ball turns in. Rowe's back leg goes up in air but Jurel fails to gather the ball behind the stumps. Australia cannot afford to neither of these two at this moment and they were mightily close from losing Rowe.
Tossed up on off and middle, Sam turns it to the leg side for a single.
Flighted on off, Fanning defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up outside off, Rowe whips it to long on for a single.
Veer bowls it flatter outside off, Rowe looks to cut but misses. That was not far away from finding the outside edge.

FOUR! Great shot! Finally some attacking intent from the Australians! Back of a length ball outside off, width on offer, Fanning cuts this one fiercely over the point fielder and the ball races away for a boundary.
Length ball on off, Fanning guides this one towards the fielder at third man.
Length ball on middle and off, defended towards the man at point.
Good length delivery on middle and off, defended off the front foot.
This time Rowe plays this length ball on the off side for a single.
On the pads, flicked towards square leg for a single.
DRINKS!
Flatter delivery on middle, driven down to long on for a single.
Flatter delivery on off, Fanning looks to defend but the ball goes off the inside edge towards square leg.
Tossed up delivery on middle, defended off the back foot towards the off side.
Floated on middle and off, driven towards wide mid off.
Shortish ball on middle and off, defended.
Floated delivery wide outside off, Rowe just opens the face of the bat and guides it in the gap at third man. The fielder there gives it a chase and does well to keep it down to 3 runs.
Siddhesh Veer is into the attack now.
Good length ball on off, driven towards mid off.
Superb fielding! Full ball on the pads, Rowe flicks this one behind square leg. Jaiswal there runs to his right, dives and does superbly to keep it down to two.
Full ball on off, pushed towards the man at wide mid off.
Full ball on middle, Rowe plays this one towards the man at mid on.
Another one way outside off, Rowe leaves it alone. The Indian bowlers need to make the Australian batters play on almost every ball.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Rowe.
Floated on off, Sam defends it off the front foot.
Short around off, Fanning cuts it to point.

Appeal for an LBW this time and even this has been turned down. Flighted outside off, Fanning looks to sweep but misses. The ball hits him on the thigh pad. The Indian players go up in a huge appeal but the umpire turns it down. Impact looked to be outside and hence the decision.

Appeal for a caught behind but the umpire shakes it away. Floated down the leg side, Fanning looks to flick but the ball kisses something and goes straight to Jurel's glove. He goes up in a confident appeal along with his teammates but the umpire turns it down. Looks like that hit the pad and yes, the replays confirm that this was a good decision by the umpire.
On the pads, Fanning flicks it fine down the leg side.
Shorter on off, Rowe gets on his back foot and punches it on the off side for a single.
Good length ball just outside off, Rowe looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man and the batters take a single.
Length ball on off, left alone.
Full ball on off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Good length ball on off, Rowe looks to play this one towards the off side but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Outside off, left alone.
Full ball wide outside off, Rowe goes for the drive but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another one which is shorter and outside off, Fanning plays it towards point.
The short of length delivery has been cut away towards the man at point.
FOUR! Played fine! Floated delivery down the leg side, Fanning plays the paddle sweep and the ball races into the fine leg fence.
Wide! Down the leg side, Fanning goes for the flick but misses.
On the pads of Fanning, he works this one towards mid-wicket. No runs taken.
Outside off, the ball pitches and turns away. Left alone by Fanning.
Wide! Down the leg side, left alone by Fanning.
Powerplay 2 time! Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.

News hearing in. Kelly who tried to take a diving catch during India's batting innings injured himself. He was taken for concussion test and the tests have shown he is concussed so he is out of this game and Liam Scott has replaced him as a concussion substitute.
Length ball on off, played towards the man at point and the batters take a single.
Good length ball just outside off, it pitches and nips away. Fanning is confident of where his off pole is and makes the leave.
Full ball on middle and off, defended towards mid on.
On the pads now, flicked towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Very full ball on off, Rowe plays the square drive through the point region and bags a boundary.
Saved by the inside edge! Good ball to start with by Akash! Full ball on middle, Rowe looks to flick but gets an inside edge and onto the pads.
Another one on off, played towards the man at point.
Bishnoi bowls this one outside off, it turns away and Fanning leaves it alone.
On the pads, flicked behind square leg for a single.
Outside off again, Rowe rocks back and guides it towards the short third man fielder.
Tossed up on off again, Rowe defends this one towards the off side.
Floated delivery on off, pushed towards the cover region.
Full ball on middle and off, defended towards mid on.
Another bouncer, Fanning will not play at those with his side in such a dangerous situation.
Bouncer outside off, Fanning sways away from it.
Back of a length ball outside off, left alone.

NOT OUT! It looks like Fanning was just looking to stop the ball from hitting his body and the third umpire says that Fanning will continue. Full ball on middle and leg, played towards the man at mid on by Fanning. The fielder there has a shy at the striker's end spotting that Fanning was just a couple of steps down the pitch. Fanning was returning and saw the ball coming towards him and blocked the ball with his hand. But his bat was grounded. The Indian players put in an enthusiastic appeal and after a brief discussion between the umpires, they take it upstairs with the soft signal as NOT OUT. After a few replays the T.V umpire shows Not Out on the giant screen.
The Indian players have appealed for obstruction of field and they are celebrating. The soft signal is NOT OUT! Fanning is the man in question.
EDGED AND FOUR! Good length ball way outside off, Fanning goes for the expansive drive but the ball goes off the thick outside edge wide of the man at second slip and into the third man fence.
Fanning rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball towards the off side for a single.
Flatter delivery on off, Fanning cuts towards the man at point.
Floated delivery just around the off pole line, Fanning looks to prod forward and defends.
Similar delivery, this time Fanning shoulders arms.
This time a flatter one on off, Fanning looks to play at it but the ball moves away and he misses.
Flatter delivery on the middle pole line, Rowe works this one towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
Leg spinner, Ravi Bishnoi is into the attack.
Good length ball just outside off, Fanning looks to defend but the ball goes off the outer half of the bat towards the slip cordon.
Good length ball on middle and off, pushed towards the man at mid off.
Wide! Another bouncer, this time on middle and leg, but it is way above Fanning's head and he lets it go.
Length ball on off, played towards the man at point now.
This time a length ball, just outside the off pole line, Fanning makes a brave and good leave.
Bouncer just outside the off pole line. Fanning does well to sway away from it.
Ohh! Close one this! Full ball on off, it pitches and moves away. Fanning looks to go for the drive but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Fuller on off, Patrick pushes it to cover to get through the over.
Full toss on off, Rowe pushes it off his back foot towards cover.

Very good fielding there by substitute Sudhir Singh. Length ball outside off, Fanning hangs on his back foot and punches it to the right of the man at point. Sudhir there dives to his right and saves a certain boundary. He cannot stop it cleanly so ends up giving a run.
On the pads, Fanning glances it to mid-wicket.

Very full pitching outside the leg stump. Sam looks to flick but misses. The ball hits him flush on the pads. Kartik and his teammates go up in an appeal. Tyagi losses his footing as he appeals but the umpire shakes it away.
Outside off on a length, Fanning leaves it alone.
Good length ball outside off, Rowe leaves it alone to get through the over.

WIDE! Ouch that looks painful. Mishra comes running in but loses his footing. His left leg slips and he goes down on the ground. The ball slips out of his hand and it goes well wide outside off. So wide that the batsman does not even think of playing that. Sushant is down on the ground holding his left ankle. He looks to be in pain but is back on his feet.
On the pads, Fanning flicks it to the leg side for a single.
WIDE! Outswinger which starts well outside off, no need for Sam to have a poke at that and he does not. Wided but the umpire. India have bowled well but need to improve their lines.
Sushant once again maintains the fourth stump line and once again Fanning is not interested.
Another one outside off, SF does not disturb that.
Length delivery outside off, Sam shoulders arms to it.
Good length ball wide outside off, Fanning looks to have a slash but misses.
Another left alone and end of a good over from Kartik. 6 off the over but a wicket as well.
Tyagi continues to tempt Rowe to drive by bowling it outside off, Patrick does not fall for it.
Good length ball outside off, this time inside the tramline. Rowe leaves it alone.
WIDE! Once again well away from the off pole. It is away from the tramline, Patrick Rowe goes for the big drive but misses and once again some work for the umpire as he stretches his arms.
WIDE! Too wide outside off, on the wrong side of the tramline and it has been wided by the umpire.
Patrick Rowe is the new man in.

OUT! Caught! Tyagi has got another one and this young man is on fire here. He is single-handedly taking down the Australian batting line-up. Maybe those words from Tyagi got under the skin of Oliver. Tyagi dishes a pacy ball away from the off stump, it is full as well. Davies goes for the big drive but ends up getting a thick outside edge which goes straight to first slip. Yashasvi Jaiswal there takes a good, sharp catch and India are on a roll here.
Aggression from the Indian pacer. He bowls a length ball outside off, Davies leaves it alone. Tyagi is not one to shy away and he says a few words to Oliver.
FOUR LEG BYES! Tyagi misses his line and sprays one down the leg side, Davies looks to flick but the ball goes off the thigh pad fine down the leg side and onto the fence.
Full and close to the off pole. Fanning pushes it to cover. Good comeback from Sushant after bowling a no ball first up and then being hit for a six from the Free Hit.
Make that 4 leaves in a row. Sushant once again bowls on the fourth stump line and Fanning is not interested at all.
Outside off and on a length, Fanning lets it carry to the keeper.
Once again Sushant bowls it away from the off pole, asking Sam to drive but he calmly lets it go.
Outside off on a length, Fanning leaves it alone.
SIX! Fanning has made the full use of the Free Hit. It is full on off, Fanning gets down on one knee and scoops it over the fine leg fence for a biggie.
FREE HIT TIME!!!
NO BALL! Sushant loses the grip of the ball and bowls a beamer first up. It is on off, Davies looks to hit it but it goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single. Free Hit to follow.
Sushant Mishra to partner from the other end with the second new ball.
Hat-trick ball negotiated by Davies! Full toss wide outside off, Davies looks to play at it but the ball goes off the outer half towards the fielder at short third man for a single.
Katik Tyagi is on a hat-trick and it will be Oliver Davies who will walk out to face the hat-trick ball. Australia in all sort of troubles in the very first over itself.

OUT! TIMBER! Inswinging yorker and the stumps are shattered! Hearne has been cleaned up and Tyagi is on a hat-trick now. Tyagi steams in, pumped up after taking the wicket of Harvey on the last ball. He bowls a ferocious inswinging yorker. Hearne tries to get his bat down in time and dig it out but the ball has gone past him way before and the bails have been disturbed. Three wickets in the first over for India and they are on a roll. Also, Tyagi on a hat-trick.
Lachlan Hearne is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Second wicket of the over and the Australian skipper departs. He is dejected and is walking back as slow as a snail. Maybe some complaints with the decision. Tyagi bowls a good length ball around the leg pole line, swinging into the skipper. Harvey looks to defend but misses the ball and is hit on the pads. The Indian players appeal and after some thought the umpire raises his finger. The Aussie skipper cannot believe that decision but he has to walk back. Perhaps, on replays, it seems like a harsh call as it was probably pitching outside the leg pole line. Is this the knockout blow for Australia, that too so early in the game?
FOUR! Full ball on middle and off, Harvey leans into the drive and has creamed that one through the cover region for a boundary.
On the pads, full ball by Tyagi, Harvey works it towards the leg side.
The skipper, Mackenzie Harvey walks out way too early then he would have been hoping for.

OUT! RUN OUT! Absolute catastrophe for Australia but super delight for India. Full ball on middle and off, Fanning pushes this one down the ground. It slowly trudges past the bowler and Fanning spots an opportunity for a single. He sets off but Fraser-McGurk is caught ball-watching. By the time he turns, his partner has reached the non-striker's end. Fraser-McGurk sets off and tries to reach the striker's end but Saxena collects the ball and throws it at the striker's end where Jurel whips the bails off. A knock on the first ball for Australia and Fraser-McGurk returns for a diamond duck.

We are back for the chase. The Indian players are in a huddle and will be looking to get a very good start. The Indian players are now taking their fielding positions with the Australian openers, Sam Fanning and Jake Fraser-McGurk following them out. Kartik Tyagi to start the proceedings with the ball.
